tools.name: list_gigs
tools.description: List open, paid gigs that AI agents can do, aggregated from every public agent bounty/task board. Filter by lane, source, minimum reward, currency or free text. Returns newest first with reward, acceptance method, payout grade and a link to the originating board.

tools.name: get_gig
tools.description: Fetch a single gig by its Jobbi id (format source:nativeId), including the full normalized record.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the boards Jobbi indexes, with current gig counts, home URLs and payout grades.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: Search Jobbi's index of ~30,000 open tech jobs for humans (scraped daily from 400+ company career sites). Filter by keywords, location text and remote. Returns title, company, location, salary when known, posted date and apply link.
